heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋雙卡輪播（箭頭與頁碼）
desc: 上方置中的標題組往上跨過區塊交界，下方一次露出兩張並排卡片的輪播，最下方置中放左右箭頭與頁碼。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組。區塊本身不往上移，只有標題組往上移，跨在本區塊和上一個區塊的交界上：小標籤落在上一個區塊的範圍內，大標題的第一行壓在交界線上。本區塊要有自己的實色底色，而且和上一個區塊的底色不同（例如淺色底），交界線才看得出來；區塊上方用區塊內的上方留白（不是外距，也不是負邊距）容納往上移的標題組，這段留白的底色和上一個區塊相同、不能透明，整個區塊從上到下都不能透出底下的內容，也不能蓋到上一個區塊的內容。標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目的輪播，對齊頁面內容寬度，一次露出兩個等寬的項目左右並排，不露出下一個；兩張卡片上緣對齊，高度依各自內容而定，不拉成等高。每個項目是一張卡片：最上方一列靠左：小頭像，可在頭像右側緊接一個小標籤，沒有時省略，這一列不延伸到卡片右緣；中段是方形圖片靠左、約佔卡片內寬三分之一，標題在圖片右側、靠上對齊；下方是說明文字，再下方可放次要文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。輪播下方置中放一組切換控制：頁碼在中間，顯示目前與總數（中間以一條短線連接），左箭頭按鈕與右箭頭按鈕分在頁碼左右兩側，和頁碼之間各隔一段明顯的距離；每次切換一組兩個項目。切換控制下方留一段較大的空白，約三分之一個畫面高，和區塊上方的留白差不多。
mobile: 標題組仍置中、跨在兩個區塊的交界線上。輪播改為一次露出一個項目，卡片靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一個項目的一部分並延伸到畫面右緣；卡片內部結構不變。切換控制維持在下方置中，改為每次切換一個項目。

en.name: Centered heading + two-up card carousel (arrows and counter)
en.desc: A centered heading group pulled up across the section boundary, above a carousel showing two cards side by side, with left/right arrows and a page counter centered below.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The section itself is not pulled up; only the heading group is moved up so it straddles the boundary between this section and the previous one: the label sits within the previous section and the first line of the headline lies on the boundary line. This section has its own solid background color that differs from the previous section (for example a light tint) so the boundary is visible. The raised heading group sits in this section's own top padding (not an outer margin and not a negative margin); that padding uses the same background color as the previous section and is never transparent, so nothing underneath shows through anywhere in the section and nothing covers the previous section's content. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a carousel of multiple items, aligned to the page content width, showing two equal-width items side by side at a time without revealing the next one; the two cards are top-aligned and each one's height follows its own content; do not stretch them to equal height. Each item is a card: the top row is aligned left: a small avatar, optionally with a label placed immediately to the right of the avatar (omit it when there is no content); this row does not extend to the card's right edge; the middle has a square image on the left taking about one third of the card's inner width, with the title to the right of the image, aligned to the top; below is a description, and below that optionally secondary text and a button; omit them when there is no content. Centered below the carousel is a set of controls: a counter in the middle showing the current and total numbers joined by a short line, with the left arrow button and the right arrow button on either side of it, each separated from the counter by a clearly visible distance; each switch advances one set of two items. Leave a fairly large empty space below the controls, about one third of a viewport tall, roughly equal to the space at the top of the section.
en.mobile: The heading group stays centered and still straddles the boundary line between the two sections. The carousel shows one item at a time: the card aligns left to the page content width, and part of the next item peeks in on the right, extending to the right edge of the viewport; the card's inner structure is unchanged. The controls stay centered below and switch one item at a time.
